newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Opta Food rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Opta Food rated buy.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Friday she started coverage of Opta Food Ingredients Inc with a speculative buy rating.
-- Opta develops, makes and markets food and beverage ingredients.
-- She set a 12-month target price range of $12 to $15 a share. Opta shares were unchanged at 5-1/2.

-- "We've tried to use what we believe is a realistic -- rather than best case -- look at earnings potential, but the variability of earnings is large given its sensitivity to sales volumes," Wittenburg wrote in a report.

-- She added that two key revenue generators for Opta today are OptaGrade, a starch-based product that can replace up to 100 percent of the fat in a variety of foods, especially dairy foods, and Opta Oat Fibers, which are primarily used by McDonald's Corp to enhance the freshness of its hamburger buns, Wittenburg said.

-- Another product in the pipeline is Fantesk, a fat replacer licensed to Opta by the U.S. Department of Agriculture. "Opta says Fantesk works in the laboratory, but the true test is whether it works outside the lab," Wittenburg said.
